name: My Little Corner
thesis: A midnight personal homepage turns Raygen’s printers, purple cat avatar, and Hack Club life into a welcoming little corner of the internet.
interaction: A playful panel toggle reveals SERV0’s aligned open assembly; a miniature site directory leads to DAVID and the real Stardance artwork.
why: The narrow personal introduction, enormous informal headline, tilted printer, and small illustrated links bring indie-web personality to a carefully composed modern page.
